stepTitle: A sine function crosses the y-axis at $$y=-2$$. Its maximum value is $$1$$, and its minimum value is $$-5$$. It attains its maximum at $$x=\frac{\pi}{4}$$ and its minimum at $$x=\frac{-\pi}{4}$$. \n The function shown is of the form $$y=A\sin(Bx)+D.$$ Identify the amplitude $$A.$$

figureAlts.figure2.gif: A sine function that crosses the y-axis through the point y equals negative 2, reaches its maximum value of y equal 1 at x equals pi over 4, and reaches its minimum value of y equals negative 5 when x equals negative pi over 4
